involved.h1: Help bring workshops to more students
involved.lede: We’re just getting started, and the people who join now help decide what we build.
involved.p1p: Tell us you’d want workshops for your students and which topics matter most. We’ll email you when we launch.
involved.p1b: I’d want this at my school
involved.p2p: Youth programs, churches, rec centers and nonprofits that serve boys and young men.
involved.p3p: Stay in the loop, suggest skills you’d like covered, and hear about family days.
involved.p4p: Adults who are handy and care about kids. We’ll share details when we launch.
involved.formH: Tell us how you’d like to help
involved.formP: Adults only, please. We’ll only use your info to send Own Two Feet updates.

monthly.lede: Run our activities with your students, on your schedule. These are planned prices, and nothing is booking yet.
monthly.g1p: Hands-on activities you run with your students, in class or after school.
monthly.g2p: Guides you can print and use with your students.
monthly.teacherP: For teachers, volunteers and community group leaders. Show proof and tell us why this rate fits you.
monthly.tl2: Or a letter from your group
monthly.teamP: One plan you share with up to two other teachers or staff at your school or group.
monthly.firstP: Schools and groups that serve low-income families get the first spots.
